ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels (approx. 85-90%) punctuated by high-intensity white pixel clusters (approx. 10-15%) distributed across the entire ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, irregular scattering of high-contrast white circular and annular blobs (2-10 pixel diameter) across both fluke lobes, with specific concentrations along the distal margins and lower density near the fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the lobe symmetry axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with prominent sharp-angled protrusions localized at the trailing margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to convex lateral tips, resulting in an upward-tapered lobe profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular white ring-like pixel clusters and solid white spots consistent with barnacle attachment scars, covering approximately 70% of the visible black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, highly visible white annular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes resulting from parasitic or epibiotic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density and uniform size distribution of the 'ring' scarring across a dark-dominant background creates a highly unique 'starfield' visual pattern.
